scope: frontend-only ChatPanel archive script and archive regression tests

findings.reproduction: Remember archive A, import or save B, allow the local backup write but reject the IndexedDB handle update, reopen the panel. Before the fix it restored A despite backup B.
findings.fix: Persist a stale-handle marker before replacing the local backup; only clear it after the IndexedDB write succeeds. Auto-restore skips marked handles. If marker persistence fails, the backup replacement is skipped too.

findings.reproduction: Delay auto-restore reading archive A, complete a manual empty import, cancelled import, or empty save, then finish the older read. Before the fix A replaced the current empty conversation.
findings.fix: Capture an operation counter for auto-restore; both manual archive entry points increment it. Every apply path rechecks that counter after asynchronous reads.

additionalRegression: A successfully remembered native file still takes precedence over its older local backup when the file is edited later.

verification.diffCheck: passed for modified source and test files
verification.environmentNote: npm was unavailable on PATH; ran the package.json test script directly with node. The existing punycode deprecation warning remains.

boundaries: Regression tests execute production archive logic and real UTF-8 temporary file bytes, while replacing browser picker and IndexedDB boundaries.
This agent did not use browser or native UI tools and does not claim proof of native Windows picker behavior or an actual browser download/import roundtrip.
If all cache writes are unavailable, completed file operations remain successful; re-opening is not guaranteed to recover the latest file without selecting it again.
Only ChatPanel script and archive tests were edited. No report, template, or style was changed by this agent.
